schema_notes: records NAME is {path: task-relative retained JSON or one JSON fence markdown, sha256: current SHA256}.
intake reads state; cp1 additionally reads data_audit, grading, decisions, safety, cp1_reviews; final additionally requires study, finals_reviews, submission, security, clean_run.
state refers to V27_STATE; its deadline is the exact deadline.calculate(ENV) object. Do not overwrite official STATE with planning targets.
spec_draft is {path,sha256}; its text must contain the data_audit record path and SHA256.
grading is {baseline:{status:UNAVAILABLE_WITH_REASON,reason:...},local_grader_used:false,holdout:{applicable:false}} until an actual grader exists. No fabricated numeric score required.

A used local grader requires evaluator_hashes,input_scope,1-3 POSITIVE controls and justified NEGATIVE controls with distinct IDs and case fingerprints. Each control records oracle:{path,sha256,origin:REQUIREMENT_DERIVED,excerpt},input/output/execution:{path,sha256},expected_metrics,actual_metrics; negatives rejected:true or relation:LOWER_THAN_KNOWN_ANSWER with known_answer_id,metric,direction and contract_reason. Control execution retains native tool/argv/request/result, matching evaluator_hashes/input_scope and exact per-control input/output refs. Its argv invokes a current bound evaluator and both absolute input/output paths; actual JSON stdout is {metrics,rejected}.

data_audit_resolution optionally records semantic review as {items:[{id,status:RECORDED,method,finding,evidence:{path,sha256},data_audit_sha256,source_hashes:{path:sha256}}]}; source_hashes must cover current audit, audited files and SPEC_DRAFT. Absent semantic evidence remains UNVERIFIED. This records review, not a guarantee of business truth.
holdout applicable:true requires looks,purpose,adaptive_selection; adaptive selection at any look or >=4 looks requires label:TUNING,independent_final_claim:false.
decisions is {type_b_cards:[{decision,chosen,why,alternative,limitations,change_location}]}. Participant acknowledgement is not a gate.
study is STUDY_BRIEF JSON; DELIVERED is actual delivery, PREPARED is only preparation. Any reduced final_minutes needs participant_choice:{path,sha256} with the actual choice.

cp1_reviews reuses base execution receipts for CONSTRAINT_RED and DATA_EVAL_RED at CP1 with current audit/SPEC scope. finals_reviews reuses the existing FINAL plan and receipts for the six core roles plus conditional SECURITY_RED at the logical CP3 phase; required_scope must cover current replay inputs/artifacts, audited sources, SPEC_DRAFT and audit evidence. previous_reviews retains the actual CP2 plan for worker/session reuse detection. Inherited-context launch facts cannot be relabelled clean.

submission/security/clean_run record refs also include execution:{path,sha256}; execution retains native {tool:actual EXECUTION_TOOLS entry,argv:[actual isolated Python invocation],request:{cmd:exact canonical command},result:{exit_code:0,output:actual JSON stdout}}. Accepted cmd is list2cmdline(argv) or shlex.join(argv), optionally prefixed by PowerShell '& '. Exact helper/root/current rules-plan binding is required. Unlisted tools, MANUAL_TRANSCRIPT and planned commands remain UNVERIFIED. Native record integrity does not authenticate identity.
snapshots lists actual snapshot manifest refs {path,sha256}; original data hashes are integrity checks, not independent backup copies.
P2 modules are optional and absent from required checks. This template is intentionally incomplete and must not pass as completed evidence.

Final baseline_comparison is AVAILABLE with comparable scoped metric evidence, or UNAVAILABLE_WITH_REASON (UNVERIFIED); hard_limits from the task text must hold; proxy_metrics are compared and reported as warnings. CURRENT_BASELINE requires best_alternative with rejection_basis.
Final external_requests is NONE or TRACKED; each tracked item is PENDING (UNVERIFIED) or RECEIVED with response_evidence.

Final maintenance requires two distinct real changed-config program executions, hash-bound before_config, after_config, program, native execution, observed_output and verification. See v27-contract.md.
Technical Type B cards must record selection_by:AI; never require participant A/B choice or approval.
time_order explicitly maps id, sequence, start, end, source; otherwise general names are auto-detected. Offset proposals are not automatic corrections.
Baseline comparison hard_limits require task source_quote and evidence; proxy_metrics retain same-scope comparison evidence and uncertainty.
Record each confirmed FINDING impact in grading.finding_impacts or explain why it is unmeasurable.
Type A choices require allowed topic and bound question/answer; type B evidence_score records metric, score and alternative_difference.
Each tracked external request records hypothesis, target, both outcomes, remaining budget and layer_check. Deadline fallback only lowers PENDING to warning for a verified submission.
